camel_example: aliyun cloud-siem SubmitImportLogTasks --region cn-hangzhou --CloudCode hcloud --ProdCode qcloud_waf --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Submits log collection tasks in batches
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem submit-import-log-tasks --prod-code qcloud_waf --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitImportLogTasks

parameters.help_en: The list of logs to be collected, in JSON array format
parameters.help_zh: 提交接入的日志列表，json数组格式
parameters.name: log_codes

parameters.help_en:
The list of accounts to be collected, in JSON array format. Valid values:
AccountId: the ID of the account to be collected. 
Imported: specifies whether to collect logs from or cancel collection for the account. Valid values:
0: Cancel collection. 
1: Collect
parameters.help_zh:
提交接入的账号列表，json数组格式。取值：
AccountId：待接入的账号ID。 
Imported：是否接入/取消接入该账号。取值：
0：取消接入。 
1：接入
parameters.name: accounts

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically collect logs from accounts that have the specified log configured. Valid values:
1: Automatically collect. 
0: Do not automatically collect
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动接入配置了该日志的账号。取值：
1：自动接入。 
0：不自动接入
parameters.name: auto_imported

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud provider
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The location of the data management center of threat detection and response. Specify the management center location based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets belong to the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: The assets belong to regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID used when an administrator switches to the perspective of another member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

Count.description_en: The number of log collection tasks that were successfully submitted
Count.description_zh: 成功提交的日志接入任务数量
Count.title_zh: 成功提交的日志接入任务数量。
